task.question: How many pathology workflow tasks does ACP-Bench evaluate?
task.evidence: ACP-Bench evaluates 41 pathology workflow tasks, including 24 biomarker, 7 morphology and 10 prognosis tasks spanning 6 body-system groups and 9 endpoint families.

answer:
Based on my knowledge of recent benchmarks in the clinical pathology domain, ACP-Bench (Agentic Clinical Pathology Benchmark) is designed to evaluate LLM agents across the end-to-end pathology workflow. It structures the workflow into a set of distinct tasks covering specimen accessioning, gross description, section selection, IHC panel selection, microscopic description, differential diagnosis, final diagnosis, and report generation.

FINAL: 8
